about: Hand-written expected reading of the fictional card tests/support/IdCardFixtures.php draws as 'passport'. Field values are normalised (dates YYYY-MM-DD); null means the field is not printed and must stay unverified. Expiry is judged on 2026-11-20 or later.
name: MAGBANUA, ROSALINDA IBARRA

missing_field.note: The passport number is left out of the visual zone only; the machine-readable zone still prints it with its check digit.
